basics.name: Naif Alassaf
basics.title: Senior Front-End Engineer
basics.summary: Senior front-end engineer with four years of experience building production interfaces for government and enterprise clients in React and TypeScript. I lead AI-assisted development on my team, which cut ticket turnaround from one week to 1.5 days, and I built an accessibility toolkit that saves over SAR 500,000 a year.

roles.title: Senior Front-End Engineer
highlights: Design front-end solutions for government cybersecurity platforms and build them in React and TypeScript, including dashboards, workflow tools, and mobile features in Flutter.
Review the team's code, run technical assessments, and mentor junior engineers.
Bring AI-assisted development into the team's daily work with custom agent skills and MCP servers, and lead the discussions that set our front-end standards.
Automate build, test, and deploy steps for the front-end projects.

roles.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Built pages, components, and internal tools for enterprise and government client projects in React, TypeScript, and Ant Design.
Built interactive Apache ECharts dashboards that show request throughput and user behavior.
Wrote end-to-end tests for critical user flows to catch regressions before release.
Represented the front end in project scoping and technical planning.

roles.title: Software Developer Intern
highlights: Fixed bugs and made improvements to user dashboards and mobile apps.
Tested web and mobile features and filed tickets for improvements.

projects.name: Saudi Trails
projects.description: An Arabic-first, bilingual map of 39 hiking trails across Saudi Arabia from the King Salman Royal Reserve and the Darb association. Filter by source, region, and difficulty, and view each route on satellite or terrain maps. A weekly build pulls Darb's public data, and every trail links to its official page.

projects.name: AI-assisted development workflow
projects.description: Set up AI-assisted development for the front-end team. Wrote custom agent skills that automate repetitive implementation work and connected MCP servers to the team's tools, which cut ticket turnaround from one week to about 1.5 days.

projects.name: Accessibility compliance toolkit
projects.description: Used across departmental domains. Cuts remediation cost by SAR 70,000 per domain, over SAR 500,000 a year. Built in one week with AI-assisted development.

projects.name: Haseen
projects.description: Saudi Arabia's national portal for cybersecurity services, with 2,500+ registered entities, 7,000+ users, and 34 e-services. Worked on several of its platforms. Built the front end of its Camunda 7 request management system, which replaced a process run over email and spreadsheets and has dashboards for request throughput and user behavior.

projects.name: Cybersecurity events dashboard
projects.description: Designed an executive dashboard for leadership with a live timeline of 300+ cybersecurity events per minute across Saudi Arabia.

projects.name: Global Cybersecurity Forum app
projects.description: Built features for the GCF mobile app in Flutter and Dart with reusable components, and shipped the first one to production within a week of learning Dart.

projects.name: Form builder
projects.description: A form builder that several front-end projects reuse. It handles many input types, validation rules, and conditional fields, so new projects no longer rebuild forms from scratch.

projects.name: Phishing detection browser extension
projects.description: Lightweight extension that flags likely phishing sites for non-technical users, bringing enterprise-grade protection into everyday browsing.

projects.name: CRD mobile app, CU Boulder Correll Lab
projects.siteName: CRD App, CU Boulder Psychology Department
projects.description: Updated the Psychology Department's Cross Racial Deficit research app and added game elements. Simplified deployment, wrote documentation, and redesigned the UI.

projects.name: Eidiyah
projects.description: A gift exchange randomizer for Eid. Enter the participants, mark any pairs who shouldn't gift each other, and get a random assignment that follows those rules.

education.degree: B.S. Computer Science, minor in Space
